scope: Sanitized source, tests, docs and selected development evidence; excludes credentials, private answers, raw sessions, SQLite, dependencies, builds, working files and recordings.
credentialScan: Exact actual private environment values and JSON/URL/base64 encodings checked across every release file and staged blob. No values retained. Known-pattern scan and binary limitations are recorded separately.
binaryLimit: Literal byte scan covers binaries; it does not perform OCR or guarantee absence of every unknown secret. Sensitive-context screenshots were visually inspected.
archiveVerification: Final ZIP CRC, complete byte inventory and private-value checks are executed by the packager. Hash and results are recorded in adjacent WORLD-PATCH-package-summary.json.
